column1: # /Graph Type Features Frame Y-Axis — toggle the inner y-axis line.
# Slice F (frame y-axis) of GRAPH_PLAN.md. Until this slice the
# Y-Axis leaf was a NotImplemented stub; the panel had no row for
# it and `FrameMask` had no field. After: a real toggle that draws
# a `│` line just inside the Left frame edge (between the outer
# frame and the data plot), at column 1 when frame.left is also on.
# Seed A1..A4 = 1..4 so a Bar chart has shape and the data fills
# /GTFF Y-Axis Yes — Type Features → Frame → Y-Axis → Yes.
# F10 — graph view. Column 0 holds the frame's outer left edge
# (`│`); column 1 — which would otherwise have been data — now
# /GTFF Y-Axis No — turn it back off.
